$comment: ACM type:style -> the wp-ja-nova pattern that renders it, field by field, for the seeder (seed.mjs renderAcm, `${type}:${style}`). Field names are the Joomla ACM field names VERBATIM, plus the fields tasks/ja-nova-wp7/tools/fix-spec.mjs writes around seeder limits (RUN.md skill issues): the T4 module chrome (S-07: main-section, bottom-desc, title-btn, link-btn), an accent split into parts <f>, <f>-accent, <f>-mid, <f>-accent-2, <f>-end (S-08: the accent's colour and decor icon are jn-a1-*/jn-a2-* classes on the section root), per-row style keys as `variant` (class cta-<value>) and a button style as `link-style` (S-10), `align` for the picture side, `number` for a numbered row and `video` for the play link (S-11). metadata.name is <type>.<field>[.<n>]; the wrapper of a repeated row is <type>.item.<n>; a repeated field drawn outside the wrapper (the pricing tab labels) repeats on its own. A block is located by name, never by position.

views.$comment: search is com_finder at /smart-search on the source; the theme answers that path with its search view (inc/extra.php wp_ja_nova_search_request), so the seeder adds no redirect for it. single is not declared: the two single-view routes (/blog-detail, /project/project-detail) open a post the seeder keeps in its category and reaches through its single-view redirect (301); an article at its listing path (/category-blog/<alias>) is answered by the theme (inc/extra.php wp_ja_nova_listing_post_request). page-account: a guest at /user-profile is sent to the login page with a 303, as Joomla's profile view does (inc/extra.php wp_ja_nova_account_redirect).
